description: This file is the implementation of the FireboltMediaPlayer plugin for WPEFramework, providing media playback control and management, including stream creation, loading, playback commands, configuration, and event notification.

classes.name: FireboltMediaPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing media player plugin with creation, control, deinitialization, and event notification functionalities.

methods.name: MediaStreamProxy::~MediaStreamProxy
methods.description: Destructor for the media stream proxy.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::Release
methods.description: Releases the media stream proxy, unregistering and releasing underlying media stream.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the media player plugin, creating and setting up media resources.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::Deinitialize
methods.description: Releases all resources, unregisters notifications, and cleans up media streams.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::Information
methods.description: Provides plugin information; currently a placeholder returning an empty string.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, potentially on a different thread.

methods.name: FireboltMediaPlayer::RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers plugin commands for external invocation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new media stream with a given ID, or returns success if it already exists.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases and deletes a media stream associated with a given ID.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a URL into a media stream identified by ID and optionally auto-plays.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sets the media stream with the specified ID to play.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the media stream with the specified ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in seconds within the media stream.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the media stream with the specified ID.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration for a specified media stream using JSON parameters.

methods.name: setDRMConfig
methods.description: Sets DRM configuration for a specified media stream using JSON parameters.

methods.name: onMediaStreamEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event related to a media stream to notify other components.
